title: PHP Basics: Variables, Data Types aur Operators
objectives: PHP file ka structure aur `<?php` tag samajhna
Variables (`$name`) banana aur `echo` se output dena
String, int, float, bool, array aur null types pehchanna
PHP file terminal se run karna
prerequisites: PHP 8.2 ya upar installed (`php -v` se check karo)
Koi bhi code editor (VS Code recommended)

sections.heading: PHP aur Laravel ka rishta
sections.body:
Laravel ek **PHP framework** hai. Laravel mein jo bhi likhoge, woh PHP hi hai: routes, controllers, models, sab. Isliye Laravel seekhne se pehle PHP ki neev pakki honi chahiye.

PHP server par chalti hai, aur browser ko HTML (ya JSON) bhejti hai.

callout.text: Laravel 11 aur 12 ko **PHP 8.2+** chahiye. Laravel 13 ko **PHP 8.3+** chahiye. Is course ka code modern PHP 8 style mein hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Product ki details
sections.body: Ek online store mein har product ke paas naam, price, stock aur availability hoti hai. PHP mein har ek cheez ek **variable** mein store hoti hai, aur variable ka ek **type** hota hai (text, number, true/false).

sections.heading: Syntax: pehla PHP program
sections.body: PHP code `<?php` se shuru hota hai. Variable ka naam `$` se shuru hota hai. Neeche wala code edit karke dekho (yahan run nahi hota, apne computer par chalao).

code.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$name = 'Wireless Mouse';
$price = 799.50;
$stock = 12;
$inStock = $stock > 0;

echo "Product: {$name}\n";
echo "Price: Rs. {$price}\n";
echo 'In stock: ' . ($inStock ? 'Haan' : 'Nahi') . "\n";

explain: `declare(strict_types=1);` – type checking strict kar deta hai (file ki pehli statement honi chahiye).
`"...{$name}..."` – double quotes ke andar variable ki value aa jaati hai (interpolation). Single quotes mein nahi aati.
`?:` – ternary operator: condition sahi ho to pehli value, warna doosri.

sections.heading: Data types
sections.body:
PHP mein sabse common types:

- `string` – text, jaise `'Laravel'`
- `int` – poora number, jaise `2026`
- `float` – decimal number, jaise `4.8`
- `bool` – `true` ya `false`
- `array` – values ki list
- `null` – koi value nahi

Function mein type likhne se galtiyan jaldi pakdi jaati hain.

code.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$title = 'Laravel';
$year = 2026;
$rating = 4.8;
$published = true;
$tags = ['php', 'web'];
$author = null;

var_dump($year, $rating, $published);

function addGst(float $amount, int $percent): float
{
    return $amount + ($amount * $percent / 100);
}

echo addGst(1000, 18); // 1180

explain: `var_dump()` value ke saath uska type bhi dikhata hai.
`float $amount` – parameter ka type. `: float` – function kya return karega.
`strict_types=1` ke saath `addGst('1000', 18)` likhoge to TypeError aayega, kyunki `'1000'` string hai.

sections.heading: Operators: == vs ===, ?? aur ?:
sections.body: Sabse zaroori farak: `==` sirf value compare karta hai, `===` value aur type dono.

code.code:
<?php

var_dump(5 == '5');   // true  (value same hai)
var_dump(5 === '5');  // false (type alag hai)

$city = $_GET['city'] ?? 'Delhi';   // value na ho to default
$stock = 0;
$label = $stock > 0 ? 'Available' : 'Out of stock';

echo $city . ' - ' . $label;

explain: `??` (null coalescing) – left side set na ho ya `null` ho to right side ki value milti hai. Laravel mein bahut use hota hai.

callout.text: Aadat daal lo: hamesha `===` use karo. Isse type-confusion wale bugs nahi aate.

versionDiff.heading: PHP version aur Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Is lesson ka syntax teeno versions mein same chalta hai. Farak sirf minimum PHP version ka hai.

items.11: PHP 8.2 se 8.4 tak. Is lesson ka poora code chalega.
items.12: PHP 8.2 se 8.5 tak. Poora code same.
items.13: PHP 8.3 se 8.5 tak. Naye project mein 8.3 ke features bina soche use kar sakte ho.

errors.cause: Variable banane se pehle use kiya, ya naam ka spelling alag hai (PHP case-sensitive hai: `$Name` aur `$name` alag hain).
errors.fix: Variable ka naam check karo aur use pehle define karo.

errors.error: Parse error: syntax error, unexpected token
errors.cause: Semicolon `;` ya bracket/quote band karna bhool gaye.
errors.fix: Error line ke upar wali line bhi dekho. `php -l file.php` se syntax check karo.

errors.error: TypeError: Argument #1 ($amount) must be of type float, string given
errors.cause: `strict_types=1` ke saath galat type pass kiya.
errors.fix: Sahi type bhejo, ya zarurat ho to `(float) $value` se cast karo.

debug.body: Variable ki value aur type dekhne ke liye `var_dump()` use karo. Syntax check ke liye `php -l`.

exercise.intro: Ek `profile.php` file banao aur terminal se chalao:
tasks: `$name`, `$age`, `$city` variables banao aur ek sentence print karo
`var_dump()` se har variable ka type dekho

options: `===` value aur type dono check karta hai
quiz.why: `===` strict comparison hai: value aur type dono same hone chahiye.

options: `id` set na ho ya null ho to 1 use hoga
quiz.why: `??` default value deta hai jab left side set na ho ya null ho.

quiz.q: Variable ka naam kis character se shuru hota hai?
quiz.why: PHP variables `$` se shuru hote hain.

interview.a: `==` loose comparison hai (type convert karke compare karta hai). `===` strict hai: value aur type dono same hone chahiye.
Us file mein function calls ke liye strict type checking on karta hai. Galat type (jaise string ki jagah int) dene par TypeError aata hai.
`null` ka matlab value hai hi nahi. `''` ek valid string hai jo khali hai. `isset()` null par false deta hai.
Null coalescing operator. Left side defined aur non-null ho to wahi value, warna right side ki value.

interview.q: Single quote aur double quote strings mein farak?
interview.a: Double quotes mein variables aur escape sequences (`\n`) process hote hain. Single quotes mein nahi.

summary: PHP code `<?php` se shuru hota hai, variables `$` se.
Main types: string, int, float, bool, array, null.
Laravel 11/12 ko PHP 8.2+, Laravel 13 ko PHP 8.3+ chahiye.
